INTEGRATED SCIENCE — PREMIUM EXAM 17
====

EXAM BODY: KJSEA
GRADE: Grade 8 JSS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100

INSTRUCTIONS
----
• Answer all questions.
• For calculations, show full working (formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units).
• Diagrams provided are part of the question — use every labeled value.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A learner writes calcium as CA. What is the correct symbol and rule? (1 mark)
   A. Ca — first letter capital, second letter small
   B. CA — both letters must be capitals
   C. ca — both letters must be small
   D. C — calcium uses only one letter

2. Why is table salt (NaCl) classified as a compound? (1 mark)
   A. It contains sodium and chlorine chemically joined in a fixed ratio
   B. It is white and looks pure
   C. It melts when heated
   D. It is mined at Lake Magadi only

3. Which change is physical? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Baking soda reacting with vinegar to make a new gas

4. Which property of liquids is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Definite volume, no definite shape
   B. Definite shape and definite volume
   C. No definite volume and no mass
   D. Always denser than every solid

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread the burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction that forms a precipitate
   D. Heating a solid until it melts

7. In osmosis, what mainly moves across a selectively permeable membrane? (1 mark)
   A. Water
   B. Sand grains
   C. Whole sugar crystals only
   D. Electric current

8. Eyepiece ×10 and objective ×4. What is total magnification? (1 mark)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. Correct option: A — Ca — first letter capital, second letter small

2. Correct option: A — It contains sodium and chlorine chemically joined in a fixed ratio

3. Correct option: A — Ice melting to water

4. Correct option: A — Definite volume, no definite shape

5. Correct option: A — Water can spread the burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

6. Correct option: A — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

7. Correct option: A — Water

8. Correct option: A — ×40
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Total magnification = eyepiece × objective
2. Substitute values: Total = 10 × 4
3. Total = 40
Final Answer: ×40
Marks: M1 multiply; A1 answer

9. Correct option: A — 1680 Pa
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: P = F / A
2. Substitute values: P = 420 / 0.25
3. P = 1680
Final Answer: 1680 Pa
Marks: M1 substitute; A1 Pa

10. Correct option: A — Chemical → electrical → light (+ heat)

11. Correct option: A — Ferrum

12. Correct option: A — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical or physical means

13. Correct option: A — Ca — first letter capital, second letter small

14. Correct option: A — It contains sodium and chlorine chemically joined in a fixed ratio

15. Correct option: A — Ice melting to water

16. Correct option: A — Definite volume, no definite shape

17. Correct option: A — Water can spread the burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

18. Correct option: A — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

19. Correct option: A — Water

20. Correct option: A — ×40
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Total magnification = eyepiece × objective
2. Substitute values: Total = 10 × 4
3. Total = 40
Final Answer: ×40
Marks: M1 multiply; A1 answer

21. Correct option: A — 1680 Pa
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: P = F / A
2. Substitute values: P = 420 / 0.25
3. P = 1680
Final Answer: 1680 Pa
Marks: M1 substitute; A1 Pa

22. Correct option: A — Chemical → electrical → light (+ heat)

23. Correct option: A — Ferrum

24. (6 marks)
Fuel, heat, oxygen. For oil fires, do not use water; smother/cover to cut oxygen and get help / evacuate if needed.

25. (6 marks)
Osmosis: water moves across a selectively permeable membrane from dilute toward more concentrated solution. Water enters the tubing; it swells/gains mass.

26. (5 marks)
Chemical energy (cells) → electrical energy (circuit) → light energy + heat energy (bulb).

27. (5 marks)
An element is a pure substance of one kind of atom and cannot be broken down chemically/physically into simpler substances (e.g. copper in wires, Fe in a jembe). A compound is made when different elements join chemically in fixed proportions (e.g. NaCl table salt, H₂O).

28. (6 marks)
Melting ice: still H₂O, no new substance, reversible by freezing → physical. Burning paper: ash/gases form, new substances, not simply reversible → chemical.

29. (8 marks)
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: P = F / A
2. Substitute values: P = 200 / 0.5
3. P = 400
Final Answer: 400 Pa
Marks: M1 formula/substitution; A1 final answer with Pa

30. (6 marks)
Fuel, heat, oxygen. For oil fires, do not use water; smother/cover to cut oxygen and get help / evacuate if needed.

31. (6 marks)
Osmosis: water moves across a selectively permeable membrane from dilute toward more concentrated solution. Water enters the tubing; it swells/gains mass.
